topic: Why can a busy day leave the important work untouched?

beats.title_en: A full day. Still no progress.
beats.narration: Messages, meetings, little tasks—one after another.
beats.subtitle_en: Messages, meetings, little tasks—one after another.

shots.scene: A person faces stacks of task papers, message cards, and a clock.
shots.element_motion: The clock turns; three task sheets slide in at different times; notifications pop up one by one; the person's head and arms react, then settle.

beats.narration: Getting back into a task takes more than a second.
beats.subtitle_en: Getting back into a task takes more than a second.

shots.scene: A phone alert interrupts the work; the task progress resets and the person's arm stops.
shots.element_motion: The phone gives a short shake; the person looks over; progress falls to zero; a restart arrow turns once and settles.

beats.title_en: Finish the one thing that matters.
beats.narration: Everything else can wait until it is done.
beats.subtitle_en: Everything else can wait until it is done.

shots.scene: Distractions leave the frame; the person focuses on one task sheet, writes, and finishes with a check mark.
shots.element_motion: Messages and side tasks move out; the phone settles on mute; the writing arm moves; ink draws across the page; the check mark completes last.
